branches.line: Three real photos of Florida’s three branches at work in Tallahassee: the Florida House (2014), the governor signing a bill (2013), and the Florida Supreme Court building (2019). Florida House of Representatives and State Archives of Florida (public domain).

const1838.line: Page 1 of Florida’s first constitution, written by hand in 1838 at the town of St. Joseph, while Florida was still a territory. State Archives of Florida, through the Library of Congress. Free to use.
